messages:
Mike: Just merged the prod-hotfix branch — noticed main CI turned red immediately on the smoke suite. Failing test looks like graphql-smoke::test_connection_blink. CI: https://ci.redwood/invocations/1212
CI-bot: test failed in step 'smoke-gpu' — exit code 1
Asha: pinging for owners to grab quick triage, can someone eyeball? @Jen @Sam
Jen: I'll take a look in ~2m, can you paste the failing snippet?
Mike: attaching snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 200 got 503
... stack trace ...
test_connection_blink at smoke/test_graphql.py:42
```
Sam: 503 from gateway usually points at an upstream transient. I saw something similar yesterday but it recovered.
Jen: can we rerun the smoke job first? usually one rerun will tell if it's flaky.
Mike: kicked a rerun: https://ci.redwood/builds/1213 (rerun requested by @Mike)
CI-bot: rerun queued by Mike — build 1213 started
CI-bot: build 1213 completed — FAILED (same test failed)
Asha: same failure after rerun. @Sam can you bisect or at least git-blame the test?
Sam: on it. What's the merge commit range? last merge was 0a1b2c3 -> 9f8e7d6 per the merge log.
Mike: merged PR #6789 — head sha 9f8e7d6
Sam: running the smoke locally against 9f8e7d6... reproduces the 503.
Sam: quick grep shows no flaky marker on the test. My early hypothesis: change in gateway backoff/timeouts in commit 0a1b2c3.
Jen: if it's a gateway timeout, could be config change. Can we temporarily route smoke to previous gateway variant or revert the change?
Asha: let's avoid an immediate revert unless we have to. Sam, please bisect to narrow down which commit introduced the regression. If it's definitely config we can do a targeted revert.
Sam: starting git bisect now, will post the first bad commit.
CI-bot: FYI — merge-triggered pager alerts go out if main stays red for > 10m.
Mike: tagging release manager @Olga — heads-up on potential rollout hold.
Olga: saw the pager, oncall already noticing. I'll pause further rollouts until we clear main.
Sam: bisect completed: first bad commit is 3c2b1a4 — this changed gateway backoff behavior (reduced retries & raised 503 propagation).
Jen: ok, thanks. Looks like a behavior change in gateway made the smoke brittle. Can someone open an immediate revert PR so we get main green?
Mike: creating revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/6821 — reverts gateway backoff change.
Asha: added emergency/urgent label and requested CI priority run.
CI-bot: PR 6821 CI started with priority queue.
CI-bot: PR 6821 CI passed all checks.
Jen: approving and will fast-track the merge.
Mike: merged revert — monitoring main CI runs post-merge.
CI-bot: main CI smoke run triggered after merge — PASSED
Asha: Nice. Follow-up: Sam to write a short postmortem on root cause and add a flaky marker or adjust the test timeout if needed.
Sam: will draft a 5-10 line note in #eng-infra and add a flaky marker to the test if we decide that's appropriate. Also will propose a safer gateway backoff config for a canary rollout.
Mike: Closing out here — thanks all for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
